purpose: City-specific official registry/cadastre and safe anonymous parcel-geometry discovery.
assessment: Layer 0 metadata shows polygon features with a Base_Syno survey-number field and service extent covering the locator. A single exact-point query limited to FID,Base_Syno and geometry returned HTTP 400 for unsupported GeoJSON output; the equivalent documented JSON query timed out. The separate dharani_data layer exposes FarmerName and MobileNo fields and was not queried. No parcel geometry or feature identifier was retained.
registryAssessment: The official Warangal District government land-records page links to Telangana’s integrated land registry and identifies the local Tahsil/Collectorate. Telangana’s official Bhu Bharati GIS describes parcel-information map interaction; however, no safe public geometry response has been verified at this locator.
